Summary: SHARED_PATENT_ASSIGNMENT: provision the PatentsView key, make lookups subject-scoped and verify relationships pass matching, admission, persistence and snapshot consumption
Description: 1) Original intent: SHARED_PATENT_ASSIGNMENT was ratified 2026-10-01; its producer runs as an app-level sync limited to seven CPC clusters, is not subject-scoped, and the local proxy answers 503 (key not provisioned), so no relationship exists in the store. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) the PatentsView key is provisioned server-side by the Founder (never printed or committed); (b) a subject-scoped lookup finds patents by the subject's assignee identity (assignee resolved to a registrant by the matching rules; ambiguous or unmatched assignees stay unresolved); (c) relationships pass the ratified admission rule, persist to the store and enter the snapshot with provenance; (d) at least one benchmark subject produces a persisted, subject-bound TECHNOLOGY relationship shown on Analysis, MAP and History; (e) the cluster whitelist is stated as a coverage limit in the output when it applies; (f) no relationship from co-presence or query text. 3) Current implementation state: not started; producer and sync traced (patentsviewconnector.js, app.jsx lines 804 and 837); proxy 503 on this machine 2026-10-11. 4) Dependencies: Founder provisions the key; KRYL-1407 (name resolution); KRYL-1402 (store); KRYL-1398 (snapshot). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (TECHNOLOGY coverage). Not delivered coverage until it produces valid, persisted, subject-bound relationships.
